_doc: Animals: wild ones to hunt and tame ones to herd. Nobody owns them at first (the sim's 'gaia' owner). behaviour: flee (bolts a few tiles when hurt), fight (turns on whoever hurts it), herd (belongs to the first player whose unit comes within claim_tiles; can be led and slaughtered). A dead animal leaves a carcass: food to gather where it fell.

spawn._doc: per player start: count at a ring of min..max tiles (with "size": that many herds of that size); then wild herds over the open map, away from starts. A map may bring its own spawn in this shape (data/maps/*.json "animals"); on a "symmetry": "rotate" map the second start gets the first one's animals turned half a turn and each wild herd a twin
